The *featuregate* will be enabled by default, but the *feature* will be off by default as it is an experimental feature.  Enabling the featuregate just enables the cluster-admin to enable the feature by explicitly setting the new API field.

Some tests are failing on this PR because the PR promotes the featuregate to the Default featureset, but the in-payload CRD for the Default featureset still doesn't have the API field.  

Our plan of action is as follows:

1. Merge https://github.com/openshift/origin/issues/30999 to make the tests pass when the featuregate is enabled but the API field doesn't exist.  
2. Merge https://github.com/openshift/api/pull/2788 (this PR) to promote the featuregate to Default.  
3. Merge https://github.com/openshift/cluster-ingress-operator/pull/1416 to get the updated CRD into a payload.
4. Revert https://github.com/openshift/origin/issues/30999 once the updated CRD is in a payload.

https://github.com/openshift/origin/pull/30999 has merged.  Let's see whether the changes in it get picked up if we rerun a CI job now.

- `[Monitor:legacy-networking-invariants][sig-network] pods should successfully create sandboxes by adding pod to network`.  I will watch for it to occur again before I report it.
